plainText:
Takanori Hoshino (Japanese: 星野貴紀 Hoshino Takanori) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Hoshino was born on May 8, 1980, in , , and became a voice actor as an adult. He was affiliated with Office PAC. Hoshino became involved with during , voicing two characters: Jervis, 's butler in Undella Town; and Dirk's . He also voiced Bruno, a member of the Kanto Elite Four, in Pokémon Generations.
